name: Shaanxi Sirui Advanced Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Shaanxi Sirui Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells copper alloy materials and products, and other special copper alloy series materials. The company offers high strength and high conductivity copper alloys, medium and high voltage contact materials, high-performance chromium powders, CT and DR tube components, and other new industrial products, as well as components of medical imaging.
